Container.Name: nocturne-gateway
Container.Overview: Step 4 of 4: Nocturne routing gateway. Requires all other Nocturne templates and files generated by prepare.sh. Point your existing HTTPS reverse proxy at Unraid port 1612 and preserve Host, X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto. No bundled Watchtower or Docker socket access. Community packaging, not an official Nocturne product.
Container.Requires: Run nocturne/prepare.sh before installation. Requires all four Nocturne containers, a custom Docker network named nocturne, generated private environment files and an HTTPS reverse proxy. See ReadMe.

Config.Name: HTTP gateway port
Config.Description: Forward your HTTPS reverse proxy to this port. Keep API, web and PostgreSQL private.
